enable.title: Give this group its own copy?
enable.text: “{name}” gets its own copy of {version}, to change from its feedback. Its links keep working and show the copy; open feedback moves with it. The course’s own lessons don’t change.
enable.textLessons: “{name}” gets its own copy of its lessons, to change from its feedback. Its links keep working and show the copy; open feedback moves with it. The course’s own lessons don’t change.

closeConfirm.title: Close the group’s lessons?
closeConfirm.text: For when the group has finished. Learners can still read them and nothing is deleted, but they stop syncing to Obsidian. You can reopen them later.

disable.title: Use the course’s lessons instead?
disable.text: Only while the copy is untouched: links and feedback move back to the course’s lessons and the copy is deleted. Once it has changes or improvements, close it instead.
